# PdfExtractor v0.6.0 - Table of Contents

A lightweight Elixir library for extracting text from PDF files using Python's pdfplumber.
Supports single and multi-page extraction with optional area filtering.

## Pages

- [PdfExtractor](https://pdf-extractor.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://pdf-extractor.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://pdf-extractor.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [PdfExtractor](https://pdf-extractor.hexdocs.pm/PdfExtractor.md): 
A powerful and easy-to-use Elixir library for extracting text and metadata from PDF files.
